nl_statement: To cut a given rectilinear angle in half. Let $BAC$ be the given rectilinear angle. So it is required to cut it in half.    <prf>  Thus, angle $DAF$ is equal to angle $EAF$ [Prop.~1.8]. Thus, the given rectilinear angle $BAC$ has been cut in half by the straight-line $AF$.
